focus: Agent runtime mirrors across seven runtimes: authority, checks, and uncovered drift
noveltyJustification: Three findings are fully new verification results (round one D2 closed, the Hermes persona check runs only in CI, and three OpenCode-dialect copies lack a mutual equality check), and one reconfirms the adapter-thinness model as adopted.
keyQuestions: Which Ponytail teachings improve the four code-working agent definitions (.skilled/agents/code.md, review.md, debug.md, orchestrate.md) and their runtime mirrors, and which are already adopted there?
answeredQuestions: Which Ponytail teachings improve the four code-working agent definitions (.skilled/agents/code.md, review.md, debug.md, orchestrate.md) and their runtime mirrors, and which are already adopted there?

ruledOut.approach: Add per-host verification records for every runtime adapter
ruledOut.reason: Round one deferred this already; the doctor and CI prove freshness structurally, and a hand-kept host-version table would be a second source of truth that rots.
